native_changes: Remove unused windows.h; the userDefine.nesting.NN property keys are formatted whole by nestingProperty (snprintf into a 32-byte buffer) in place of _itoa into a two-digit placeholder

Local UDLWordList view supplies SetWordAt/StartAt without changing the pinned dependency ABI; the lexer owns one view per word list, clears them all when WordListSet changes a list and rebuilds them before the next lex, with a 256-entry first-byte table as upstream WordList has

Upstream's multi-part keyword reorder loop is moved unchanged from the start-of-document block of ColouriseUserDoc into ReorderMultiPartKeywords and run over all 15 lists when any list changes, so lexes that start past offset 0 use the same order; the earlier stable_sort is removed

Own 15 UDL keyword lists in a DefaultLexer subclass with its own PropSetSimple, rather than indexing upstream 9-list LexerBase storage; upstream's empty FoldUserDoc, four-entry word-list description and LexerModule lmUserDefine are omitted, and DescribeWordListSets names the 15 lists
Per-lexer generated cache identifiers replace pointer truncation; Release erases cache entries
ScintillaEditView::setUserLexer's quoted-keyword encoding (white space inside double or single quotes becomes \v or \b) is re-implemented in Swift as UserDefinedLanguage.words
UserConstants.h is a heading line followed by the SCLEX_USER and SCE_USER lines of SciLexer.h, verbatim
LexUser.patch is the complete difference between the pinned lexilla/lexers/LexUser.cxx and the ported LexUser.cxx; scripts/check-user-lexer-port.py verifies it and the hashes under port and patch
limitations: Native semantic fixtures cover keywords, ignore-case, comments and delimiters; complete UDL feature matrix remains open
Case matching retains upstream byte-oriented behavior; Unicode case equivalence is not certified

Imported chromatic style RGB is retained; a style with no fgColor, with colorStyle lacking the foreground bit, or with a near-black or near-white fgColor follows the light/dark text colour instead; bgColor is not applied; exact UDL colorStyle/font face/size parity remains open

A keyword that is the last word of a document with no final line break is left unstyled until a line break or space follows it; the lexing loop that decides this is unchanged from the pinned upstream source, and Notepad++'s behaviour on Windows has not been observed
